intro.note: Answer each question in your workbook. Show your working.
commonMistakes: A must satisfy 1 ≤ A < 10. So 36 × 10⁴ is wrong; correct: 3.6 × 10⁵.
Positive power = big; negative power = small.
intro.visualAid: Place-value slide showing the decimal point moving left for big numbers (positive power) and right for small numbers (negative power). Arrow diagram: 5,600,000 → 5.6 (6 places left) = 5.6 × 10⁶. And 0.0034 → 3.4 (3 places right) = 3.4 × 10⁻³.

questions.content: Not standard form? Fix: a) 5.6 × 10³  b) 36 × 10⁴  c) 0.8 × 10⁻²  d) 7 × 10⁹
Hydrogen atom mass ≈ 0.00000000000000000000000167 kg. Standard form?
Earth–Sun = 1.5 × 10⁸ km; Earth–Mars = 2.3 × 10⁸ km. a) Sun distance ordinary. b) Closer? c) Difference in standard form.
Bacterium = 2 × 10⁻⁶ m; virus = 3 × 10⁻⁸ m. a) How many times longer? b) 500 bacteria end-to-end? c) Viruses in 1 mm?
